dct_description_sm: The Capital Budget & Forecast Facilities and Buildings layer represents the various Parks and Open space and Facility improvements and construction locations found throughout the city. These projects have all been identified in the capital budget and scheduled from the current year until 10 years from then. The items from Year 2-10 are part of the capital forecast and could be subject to change as priority setting and budget funding levels change.
